changelog:
- Initial release of the huawei-cloud-rds-list skill.
- Lists Huawei Cloud RDS (Relational Database Service) instance names for the current tenant/project.
- Supports optional filtering by instance name, id, type (Single/Ha/Replica), engine (MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLServer/MariaDB), and VPC.
- Outputs only instance names by default; extra flags add details like id, status, engine, flavor, private IPs, and created time.
- Uses the `hcloud RDS ListInstances` CLI command (primary) with Python SDK fallback and quality reporting.
- Read-only: never creates, modifies, restarts, or deletes RDS instances.
summary: Query the list of Huawei Cloud RDS (Relational Database Service, 云数据库) instances under the current tenant / project and return the RDS instance NAMES. By default the skill prints only the instance names (one per line); with extra flags it also returns id, status, engine type, flavor, private IPs and created time. Supports filtering by instance name, id, type (Single/Ha/Replica), datastore engine (MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQLServer/MariaDB) and VPC, plus pagination via limit/offset. Uses the KooCLI command `hcloud RDS ListInstances --cli-region={region}` (primary) or the huaweicloudsdkrds Python SDK (fallback). Read-only — never creates, modifies, deletes, restarts or stops any RDS instance. Use this skill whenever the user wants to list/inspect the RDS instances of the tenant or query the RDS instance name list, e.g. for database inventory, daily inspection, or cost review. Triggers include: "list RDS", "RDS list", "query RDS names", "RDS实例列表", "查询RDS", "RDS实例名称", "rds list", "how many RDS", "RDS inventory", "list database instances", "云数据库实例".
